newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel sees some growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel sees some growth in 1997.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Wednesday that economic prospects in 1997 were in its favour.

"Economic prospects in 1997 are in our favour: continued - albeit moderate - growth and low inflation. In our most important markets, on average, somewhat higher growth rates are expected than in 1996," chairman Cees van Lede said in a speech.
